title: CrystalMO-TuRBO: Multi-Objective Trust-Region Bayesian Optimization for High-precision Joint Crystal Structure Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2609.20592v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Crystal structure refinement is a fundamental inverse problem in materials characterization, where structural parameters are optimized to reproduce experimental diffraction data. Conventional approaches, such as least-squares and likelihood-based optimization, rely on local search and often struggle with non-convex, noisy, and highly correlated parameter landscapes, particularly when integrating multiple diffraction modalities. Joint refinement of X-ray and neutron data is especially challenging due to their complementary but competing sensitivities, which are typically combined through scalarized objectives requiring manual weighting and leading to suboptimal solutions. We propose CrystalMO-TuRBO, a multi-objective trust region Bayesian optimization architecture for joint crystal structure refinement. translated_title: CrystalMO-TuRBO：用于高精度晶体结构联合精修的多目标信赖域贝叶斯优化
translated_abstract: 晶体结构精修是材料表征中的一个基本逆问题，其目标是通过优化结构参数来重现实验衍射数据。传统方法（如最小二乘法和基于似然的优化）依赖于局部搜索，在面对非凸、含噪且高度相关的参数空间时常常表现不佳，尤其是在融合多种衍射模态时。X射线和中子数据的联合精修尤其具有挑战性，因为两者具有互补但相互竞争的灵敏度，通常需要通过标量化目标将其组合，这不仅需要手动设置权重，还容易导致次优解。我们提出了CrystalMO-TuRBO，一种用于晶体结构联合精修的多目标信赖域贝叶斯优化架构。该方法将X射线和中子数据的偏差建模为独立的目标，并将问题转化为归一化的最大化设置……
tldr: 提出了CrystalMO-TuRBO，一种多目标信赖域贝叶斯优化架构，通过将X射线和中子数据的偏差作为独立目标建模，避免了手动权重调节，实现了高精度的晶体结构联合精修。
en_tdlr: CrystalMO-TuRBO is proposed, a multi-objective trust-region Bayesian optimization architecture that models X-ray and neutron discrepancies as separate objectives, eliminating manual weight tuning and enabling high-precision joint crystal structure refinement.
